claim_boundary: C018 records exact attacks and narrowed bridges. One formulation is rejected; all descendants remain below proof status.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: n^k is compared with formulas of k-dependent length
attacks.method: Take L_k(n)=n^{k^2}; an L^3 SAT circuit has size n^{3k^2}>n^k for every k.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the cover bound is charged against n rather than actual length L
attacks.method: Rewrite every cover-size term in L before applying it to H124.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: no explicit high-treewidth local twins exist
attacks.method: Construct H121 toroidal Tseitin twins with charges (2,0) and (1,1).

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: local twins exist only on easy cycles
attacks.method: Replace cycles by toroidal-grid Tseitin systems while preserving exact local equality.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the SAT labels are wrong
attacks.method: Build even-charge assignments by spanning-tree elimination and reject odd-charge components by XOR summation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a radius-R root sees both SAT charges
attacks.method: Use m=8R+13 and compare complete translation-normalized signature multisets.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the local clauses encode the wrong parity
attacks.method: Enumerate the eight forbidden assignments and verify every clause on the constructed witness.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the primal graph or bound is wrong
attacks.method: Check primal-line-graph equality and isolate the published transfer in H122.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: incident graph edges fail to co-occur
attacks.method: Every local width-four clause contains all four incident edge variables.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: nonincident graph edges co-occur
attacks.method: Every clause belongs to one vertex equation and contains only incident edges.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the cited bounds do not imply m-1
attacks.method: Substitute tw(T_m)=2m-1 into tw(L(G))>=(tw(G)+1)/2-1.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: two components reduce treewidth
attacks.method: Use that disjoint-union treewidth is the maximum component width.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: identity remains legal as for H118
attacks.method: H121 has primal width Omega(sqrt(N)), outside the O(log N) output promise.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a low-width output stores component parity
attacks.method: No theorem yet excludes distributed fixed-pass aggregation of that bit.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: low treewidth need not force a common quotient
attacks.method: Keep factorization as the explicit unproved theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: annotations carry a hidden global bit
attacks.method: Require factorization of all recovery and provenance fields.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the repair still fails to imply a lower bound
attacks.method: Measure the exact SAT circuit and attacked class on the same L-bit domain.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H120 covers the generated list within L^k
attacks.method: Charge distinct witnesses and evaluator size directly against L^k.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a smaller sound circuit ignores listed witnesses
attacks.method: Leave universal SAT-sound incompressibility as the first unproved theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: padding changes the legal L-bit language
attacks.method: Require one canonical exact-length encoding and explicit padding semantics.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the cycle family cannot exclude identity
attacks.method: H121 retains the parity mechanism with linear treewidth.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: every known twin family is easy
attacks.method: Use H121 as an explicit hard-width input; H123 remains necessary.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the gadget route does not apply to H121
attacks.method: Record H121 as a source candidate without claiming transport.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: an auxiliary parameter hides circuit size
attacks.method: Route the target through H124's exact L-bit domain.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: range avoidance returns only a false positive
attacks.method: H124 keeps the soundness promise but supplies no decoder.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a transparent local construction is mistaken for hard endpoints
attacks.method: Keep H117 active; C018 claims no new endpoint family.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H121 is misused as EF gadget amplification
attacks.method: Separate SAT locality from equivalent-circuit rewrite distance.
